capabilities: Write editable text boxes, lists and native tables
Embed vault images and speaker notes
Apply theme, slide size and font settings
Split notes on --- separators like core Slides
disambiguation: Not a presentation viewer inside Obsidian; it writes a .pptx file to disk for use in external presentation software.
extras: Not yet listed in the community directory; install by downloading main.js and manifest.json from the latest release. Tested on desktop macOS only, not tried on mobile. Web images are skipped, math and Mermaid export as source, embedded notes export as their name, and slide heights are estimated rather than measured.
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn a note into an editable PowerPoint file, so slide material has to be rebuilt by hand in presentation software.

relations.evidence: one slide per separator, like the core Slides plugin

summary: Exports an Obsidian note as an editable .pptx deck with real text boxes, native tables, embedded images and speaker notes, built offline.
